decisions.reason: The organic poultry mini salami snack is still presented on its own page and is cheap to keep on existing curing lines, but two years in, a niche snack format faces growing retail delisting risk, so it is kept while the option stays open.

The organic Fleischwurst was launched recently as a new member of the organic range, builds on core sausage know-how at low holding cost, and its prospects are still unresolved, so keeping the option open is justified.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line in two flavors fits the organic and new-format direction and is still too new to reveal its value, though a multi-variant line costs somewhat more to maintain.
The organic herb-coated salami is a close, low-cost variant with uncertain but unresolved prospects, so it is kept even though recent salami withdrawals show this segment is crowded.
